'''Yrral''' was a [[Cerean/Legends|Cerean]] [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]], who lived during the waning years of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].

==Biography==
Yrral was one of three Cerean triplets who joined the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and became [[Padawan/Legends|Padawans]]. However Yrral's siblings, [[Lyrrad]] and [[Lerred]], and Yrral, all fell to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] and became Dark Jedi.

The three Cereans were present in the [[City/Legends|city]] [[Tolea Biqua]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Genarius]] during the [[SoroSuub Anniversary celebration, 31 BBY|SoroSuub Anniversary celebration]] that was held there in [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]]. After the [[heroes of Cularin]] were attacked by a group of thugs during the event, word spread to the Cereans that a group of people were wandering the streets of Tolea Biqua in search of a fight. The three Cereans decided to oblige and, along with a group of thugs, they moved to attack the heroes. While the thugs opened fire on the heroes with their [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]], Lerred, Lyrrad and Yrral looked on from a balcony. The three Dark Jedi then jumped down, ignited their [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsabers]] and joined the fight.
